title: The leak scan misses a key block whose armor header value holds a pipe or a backslash-letter, and a backslash run in a header value is quadratic
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits flags a PGP or EC key block whose header value holds a pipe (Comment: Alice | work) or a backslash-letter (Comment: C:\new), as the shape before c927cb22e did, and returns within a fraction of a second on a header value with a long backslash run, while every form the sprint's repros and its fresh review planted is still flagged and the labels alone in prose still pass

run: import base64,os,sys,time;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon;d='-'*5;b=base64.b64encode(os.urandom(96)).decode();hit=lambda t:any(k=='secret' for k,_ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t));nl=chr(10);bs=chr(92);cases={'pipe':d+'BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK'+d+nl+'Comment: Alice | work'+nl+nl+b[:64]+nl,'winpath':d+'BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK'+d+nl+'Comment: C:'+bs+'new'+nl+nl+b[:64]+nl};miss=[k for k,v in cases.items() if not hit(v)];t=d+'BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY'+d+nl+'k: a'+bs*20000+'!';s=time.time();kbcommon.leak_hits(t);e=time.time()-s;print('missed:',miss,'| 20k backslash run: %.2f s'%e);sys.exit(1 if miss or e>0.3 else 0)

gates.question: How does the armor lookahead end a header value so a pipe or a backslash-letter stays inside it? boundary = to the first gap (whitespace, escaped newline, pipe) that a header start or a 20-character base64 run follows, never past a real newline or the next armor line, all possessive; line = to the end of the line with a second alternative for single-line forms

notes: Found 2026-10-23 by the second fresh review of SP-evq2flqc (on c927cb22e): the possessive header value ends at a newline, an escaped newline or a pipe, so a free-text armor Comment: holding a pipe or a backslash-letter ends early and no 20-character base64 run follows; kbingest.SECRET_TEXT misses the same inputs. The header-value backslash alternative re-scans the run: 5k/10k/20k/40k backslashes take 0.07/0.28/1.1/4.4 s. Reviewer hints: a possessive backslash run, and end the value at a pipe only when a header or the base64 run follows. Operator 2026-10-23: changed BG-v7e36oqg g1 and fixed here in the sprint. Also a same-line log form (label, Comment: x and base64 space-separated) is lost since c927cb22e; S3, cover it if the fix allows.
